details: Earlier warnings from a former Ethereum Foundation contributor about a "slow-burning funding crisis" for Ethereum's core development have been largely neutralized. Key institutional ecosystem participants, including major corporate treasuries holding significant Ethereum allocations, have dismissed these fears and confirmed that core development funding remains secure. This reassurance has helped restore buyer confidence amidst concerns over a potential $30 million annual funding gap following the expiration of the Client Incentive Program.
title: Ethereum Funding Crisis Concerns Eased by Institutional Support

details: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) marked a significant milestone by reportedly executing its first-ever borrowing transaction on Capitol Hill. This event, amplified by Ethereum and widely shared, signals growing interest among lawmakers in understanding and engaging with DeFi technologies. While it may not have immediate monetary market implications, it represents a landmark moment for potential long-term legislative support and broader regulatory discussions for the evolving DeFi sector.
title: DeFi Conducts First-Ever Borrowing Transaction on Capitol Hill

details: Solflare, a prominent Solana-based wallet, has released new DeFi features in its latest June update. Users can now access "Card Borrows," allowing them to obtain USDC liquidity against their SOL holdings as collateral without needing to sell the underlying SOL. This USDC can then be spent via the Solflare Card, which operates on the Mastercard network, enabling users to retain SOL exposure and yield. The update also includes "Reclaim SOL" and "Titan swaps," enhancing the wallet's functionality as a comprehensive DeFi hub.
title: Solflare Wallet Introduces Card Borrows and New Swaps for SOL Holders

details: SEALSQ Corp. has been granted a landmark European patent for its 'Back-to-Physical' NFT technology. This innovative solution enables Non-Fungible Tokens to be provisioned directly into secure semiconductor chips, establishing an immutable, hardware-rooted link between digital assets and physical objects. This development is seen as a structural breakthrough for the art market, providing cryptographically sealed provenance, ownership history, and authenticity certification that is resistant to quantum threats. The company's subsidiary, WISe.ART, is set to become the world's first hardware-authenticated art platform leveraging this technology.
title: SEALSQ Secures European Patent for 'Back-to-Physical' NFT Technology

details: Bitcoin and Ethereum have seen a modest rebound in the last 24 hours, with Bitcoin increasing by 1.60% to reach $63,671.32 and Ethereum climbing 1.64% to $1,723.81. This recovery follows a recent four-day decline that saw Bitcoin drop below $62,400. Despite the price uptick, funding rates across major trading platforms indicate a cautious sentiment. Some Bitcoin funding rates have even turned negative, suggesting that the recent price increase is not yet supported by strong bullish conviction among leveraged traders. Meanwhile, Morgan Stanley has reportedly been accumulating Bitcoin through its spot Bitcoin ETF positions.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Rebound Slightly, Funding Rates Show Investor Caution
